name: Smart Content Lytics
description: Exposes Lytics user-profile fields as Smart Content conditions by deriving condition plugins from the Lytics schema API, so decisions can segment on Lytics audience data.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Description 
 The Smart Content Lytics module integrates the Lytics Personalization Engine (visitor profile) with Drupal Smart content. This allows Drupal administrators to create Smart Content based conditional blocks based on the real-time Lytics profile for your visitors.

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 Ensure you have already installed and configured the core Lytics Drupal Module . 
 Download and enable the Smart Content Lytics module. 
 Verify that you can access allowlisted Lytics attributes within Smart Content segment definition. 
 
 Back to top 

 Debugging 
 
 Debug mode can be enabled by setting the localStorage value as outlined below. As a result more comprehensive logs will be surfaced in the console:

 localStorage.lytics_smart_content_debug = true
 
 
 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 This module depends on the following Drupal core modules:

 
 drupal/lytics 
 drupal/smart_content 
 
 Lytics API token must have access to read schema and account settings.

 Back to top
